title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR) / Resolutive Database Engine
description: BDR v0.2.0-rc1 is an experimental API/ABI release candidate of the persistent key-value Resolutive Database Engine. It includes the consolidated C++ core, frozen C ABI v1, Python bindings, CMake package integration, BDW3 write-ahead logging, BDR3 checkpoints, streaming recovery, process-level locking, writer error propagation, and reproducible validation and benchmarking. The release is not represented as production-ready and does not claim strict worst-case O(1) complexity for the complete engine. The associated scientific preprint is a separate Zenodo publication with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21937842.
